claims.verbatim:
BALTIMORE, Aug 4 a 5—Arr bark Bremen (Brem), Trent-
well, Bremen;

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 14 August 1866, p. 5, col. 3 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 2 July 1866, p. 4, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The European news, dated to the 21st of June, so anx-
iously expected yesterday, had not arrived when the
HERALD went to press this morning. The steamships
Bavaria, Bremen, City of Boston and Damascus are due
at this port and off Father Point respectively.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 3 July 1866, p. 6, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
By the arrival yesterday of the steamships Bremen,
Bavaria, City of Boston and Merrimac, at this port, and
Cuba, at Halifax, we received news from Europe, by
mail and telegraph, to the 24th of June, seven days later.

NEW YORK, July 2.—The steamship Bremen,
with Liverpool dates to the 20th ultimo has
arrived.

headlines.text: Important from Europe. TWO DAYS LATER.
